INSERT INTO [dbo].[productos]
(
    id_tienda,
    referencia_producto_erp,
    id_producto_ecommerce,
    sincronizado,
    fecha_sincronizacion,
    producto_obj
)

SELECT DISTINCT
            '1' AS id_tienda,
			f120_id AS referencia_producto_erp,
			0 AS id_producto_ecommerce,
			0 AS sincronizado,
			GETDATE() AS fecha_sincronizacion,
            JSON_QUERY(
                CONCAT(
                    '{' ,
                        '"Name":"', STRING_ESCAPE(REPLACE(ISNULL(Descripcion_Ecommerce, ''), '/', '-'), 'json'), '",',
                        '"DepartmentId":', 1, ',',
                        '"CategoryId":', IdCriterioC24, ',',
                        '"BrandId":', DescripcionPlanC34, ',',
                        '"LinkId":"', STRING_ESCAPE(
                            REPLACE(
                                REPLACE(
                                    REPLACE(
                                        REPLACE(
                                            REPLACE(
                                                REPLACE(
                                                    LOWER(ISNULL(Descripcion_Ecommerce, '')), 
														'/', '-'),
													' ', '-'),
												',', ''), 
											'.', ''), 
										'(', ''), 
									')', ''), 'json'), '",',
                        '"RefId":"', STRING_ESCAPE(ISNULL(f120_referencia, ''), 'json'), '",',
                        '"IsVisible":', 'true', ',',
                        '"Description":"",',
                        '"DescriptionShort":"",',
                        '"ReleaseDate":"', FORMAT(GETDATE(), 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss'), '",',
                        '"KeyWords":"",',
                        '"Title":"",',
                        '"IsActive":', 'true', ',',
                        '"TaxCode":', 'null', ',',
                        '"MetaTagDescription":"",',  
                        '"ShowWithoutStock":', 'false', ',',
                        '"Score":', 1,
                    '}'
        )
    ) AS producto_obj
FROM OPENROWSET(
    'SQLNCLI11', 
    'Server=siesa-m4-sqlsw-db6.ceqnrhbwqaoo.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com;Database=UnoEE_Pisende_Real;Uid=Pisende;Pwd=Pisende$12$%;',
    '
	WITH ItemsConDescripciones AS (
		SELECT DISTINCT
			i.f120_id,
			i.f120_rowid,
			i.f120_rowid_movto_entidad,
			i.f120_id_grupo_impositivo,
			RTRIM(LTRIM(i.f120_referencia)) AS f120_referencia,
			RTRIM(LTRIM(i.f120_descripcion)) AS f120_descripcion,
			i.f120_descripcion_corta,
			i.f120_id_tipo_inv_serv,
			i.f120_id_unidad_inventario,
			i.f120_id_unidad_orden,
			MAX(CASE WHEN ic.f125_id_plan = ''C24'' AND cm.f106_descripcion IS NOT NULL 
					 THEN cm.f106_descripcion END) AS DescripcionPlanC24,
			MAX(CASE WHEN ic.f125_id_plan = ''C24'' AND cm.f106_id IS NOT NULL 
					 THEN cm.f106_id END) AS IdCriterioC24,
			MAX(CASE WHEN ic.f125_id_plan = ''C29'' AND cm.f106_descripcion IS NOT NULL 
					 THEN cm.f106_descripcion END) AS DescripcionPlanC29,
			MAX(CASE WHEN ic.f125_id_plan = ''C29'' AND cm.f106_id IS NOT NULL 
					 THEN cm.f106_id END) AS IdCriterioC29,
			MAX(CASE WHEN ic.f125_id_plan = ''C29'' AND ic.f125_id_plan IS NOT NULL 
					 THEN ic.f125_id_plan END) AS f125_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN ic.f125_id_plan = ''C29'' AND cm.f106_id IS NOT NULL 
					 THEN cm.f106_id END) AS f106_id,
			MAX(CASE WHEN ic.f125_id_plan = ''C29'' AND cm.f106_descripcion IS NOT NULL 
					 THEN cm.f106_descripcion END) AS f106_descripcion,
			MAX(CASE WHEN ic.f125_id_plan = ''C34'' AND cm.f106_descripcion IS NOT NULL 
					 THEN SUBSTRING(cm.f106_descripcion,1,7) END) AS DescripcionPlanC34,
			MAX(CASE WHEN ic.f125_id_plan = ''C34'' AND cm.f106_id IS NOT NULL 
					 THEN cm.f106_id END) AS IdCriterioC34
		FROM t120_mc_items i
		INNER JOIN t125_mc_items_criterios ic ON ic.f125_rowid_item = i.f120_rowid 
			AND ic.f125_id_cia = 1
			AND ic.f125_id_plan IN (''C24'', ''C29'',''C34'')  -- Filtro temprano
		INNER JOIN t106_mc_criterios_item_mayores cm ON cm.f106_id_cia = ic.f125_id_cia 
			AND cm.f106_id_plan = ic.f125_id_plan
			AND cm.f106_id = ic.f125_id_criterio_mayor
		INNER JOIN t105_mc_criterios_item_planes cp ON cp.f105_id_cia = cm.f106_id_cia 
			AND cp.f105_id = cm.f106_id_plan
			AND cp.f105_id IN (''C24'', ''C29'',''C34'')  -- Filtro temprano
		WHERE i.f120_id_cia = 1
		GROUP BY
			i.f120_id,
			i.f120_rowid,
			i.f120_rowid_movto_entidad,
			i.f120_id_grupo_impositivo,
			i.f120_referencia,
			i.f120_descripcion,
			i.f120_descripcion_corta,
			i.f120_id_tipo_inv_serv,
			i.f120_id_unidad_inventario,
			i.f120_id_unidad_orden
	),
	-- CTE para centralizar las subconsultas de atributos e-commerce
	EcommerceData AS (
		SELECT DISTINCT
			me.f750_rowid,
			MAX(CASE WHEN ea.f743_etiqueta = ''Descripcion Ecommerce'' 
					 THEN mec.f753_dato_texto END) AS Descripcion_Ecommerce,
			MAX(CASE WHEN ea.f743_etiqueta = ''Detalle Ecommerce'' 
					 THEN mec.f753_dato_texto END) AS Detalle_Ecommerce,
			MAX(CASE WHEN ea.f743_etiqueta = ''KeyWords''
					 THEN mec.f753_dato_texto END) AS KeyWords,
			MAX(CASE WHEN ea.f743_etiqueta = ''Titulo SEO''
					 THEN mec.f753_dato_texto END) AS Titulo_SEO,
			MAX(CASE WHEN ea.f743_etiqueta = ''Metadescripcion''
					 THEN mec.f753_dato_texto END) AS Metadescripcion
		FROM t750_mm_movto_entidad me
		INNER JOIN t753_mm_movto_entidad_columna mec ON me.f750_rowid = mec.f753_rowid_movto_entidad
		INNER JOIN t743_mm_entidad_atributo ea ON mec.f753_rowid_entidad_atributo = ea.f743_rowid
		WHERE ea.f743_etiqueta IN (''Descripcion Ecommerce'', ''Detalle Ecommerce'', ''KeyWords'', ''Titulo SEO'',''Metadescripcion'')
		GROUP BY me.f750_rowid
	)
	-- Consulta principal
	SELECT DISTINCT
		icd.f120_id,
		icd.f120_rowid,
		icd.f120_id_grupo_impositivo,
		icd.f120_referencia,
		icd.f120_descripcion,
		icd.f106_descripcion,
		icd.f125_id,
		icd.f106_id,
		icd.f120_descripcion_corta,
		ed.Descripcion_Ecommerce,
		ed.Detalle_Ecommerce,
		ed.KeyWords,
		ed.Titulo_SEO,
		ed.Metadescripcion,
		icd.DescripcionPlanC24,
		icd.IdCriterioC24,
		icd.DescripcionPlanC29,
		icd.IdCriterioC29,
		icd.f120_id_tipo_inv_serv AS TipoInventario,
		icd.f120_id_unidad_inventario AS IdUnidadInventario,
		icd.f120_id_unidad_orden AS IdUnidadOrden,
		icd.DescripcionPlanC34,
		icd.IdCriterioC34
	FROM ItemsConDescripciones icd
	LEFT JOIN EcommerceData ed ON ed.f750_rowid = icd.f120_rowid_movto_entidad
	WHERE icd.DescripcionPlanC29 = ''APLICA''
		AND icd.IdCriterioC24 IN (''1'', ''2'', ''3'', ''4'', ''5'', ''6'', ''7'', ''8'')
		AND icd.f106_descripcion IS NOT NULL
		AND icd.f106_descripcion <> ''''
		AND icd.f106_descripcion <> ''NO APLICA''
		AND DescripcionPlanC34 IS NOT NULL
		AND (ISNUMERIC(icd.DescripcionPlanC34) = 1 AND LEN(icd.DescripcionPlanC34)=7)
		--AND f120_id IN (''5901602'',''5901606'',''5901612'')
    '
) AS RawData
WHERE NOT EXISTS
(
    SELECT 1
    FROM productos p
    WHERE p.id_tienda = 1
      AND
      (
          p.referencia_producto_erp = CAST(RawData.f120_id AS NVARCHAR)
         OR
          LTRIM(RTRIM(
              JSON_VALUE(
                  p.producto_obj,'$.RefId'))) =LTRIM(RTRIM(RawData.f120_referencia ))
      )
)
AND ISNULL(
        RawData.Descripcion_Ecommerce,'') <> '';

INSERT INTO [dbo].[especificaciones_productos] (
    id_tienda, 
    id_producto, 
    id_producto_ecommerce, 
	sincronizado, 
    fecha_sincronizacion,
    especificacione_obj    
)

SELECT 
p.id_tienda,
p.id,
p.id_producto_ecommerce,
0,
GETDATE(),
JSON_QUERY(
	CONCAT(
		'[',
			'{"Value":["',Acabado,'"],"Name":"Acabado"},',
			'{"Value":["',Color,'"],"Name":"Color"},',
			'{"Value":["',REPLACE(Dimensiones, '"', '\"'),'"],"Name":"Dimensiones"},',
			'{"Value":["',Unidad_de_Negocio,'"],"Name":"Unidad de Negocio"},',
			'{"Value":["',Linea,'"],"Name":"Línea"},',
			'{"Value":["',Categoría,'"],"Name":"Categoría"},',
			'{"Value":["',Tipo,'"],"Name":"Tipo"},',
			'{"Value":["',REPLACE(Formatos, '"', '\"'),'"],"Name":"Formatos"},',
			'{"Value":["',Marca,'"],"Name":"Marca"},',
			'{"Value":["',Origen,'"],"Name":"Origen"},',
			'{"Value":["',Unidad_de_Empaque,'"],"Name":"Unidad de Empaque"},',
			'{"Value":["',REPLACE(Estilo, '"', '\"'),'"],"Name":"Estilo"},',
			'{"Value":["',Uso,'"],"Name":"Uso"},',
			'{"Value":["',Tráfico,'"],"Name":"Tráfico"},',
			'{"Value":["',Variacion_tono,'"],"Name":"Variación de tono"}',
		']'
		)
	)
FROM OPENROWSET(
    'SQLNCLI11', 
    'Server=siesa-m4-sqlsw-db6.ceqnrhbwqaoo.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com;Database=UnoEE_Pisende_Real;Uid=Pisende;Pwd=Pisende$12$%;',
    '
	SELECT 
	 	t120.f120_id,
	 	t120.f120_referencia,
	 	MAX(CASE WHEN t125B.f125_id_plan = ''C09'' THEN ISNULL(t106.f106_descripcion,'''') END) AS Acabado,
	 	MAX(CASE WHEN t125B.f125_id_plan = ''C10'' THEN ISNULL(t106.f106_descripcion,'''') END) AS Color,
	 	MAX(CASE WHEN t125B.f125_id_plan = ''C08'' THEN ISNULL(t106.f106_descripcion,'''') END) AS Dimensiones,
		MAX(CASE WHEN t125B.f125_id_plan = ''C01'' THEN ISNULL(t106.f106_descripcion,'''') END) AS Unidad_de_Negocio,
		MAX(CASE WHEN t125B.f125_id_plan = ''C04'' THEN ISNULL(t106.f106_descripcion,'''') END) AS Linea,
		MAX(CASE WHEN t125B.f125_id_plan = ''C23'' THEN ISNULL(t106.f106_descripcion,'''') END) AS Categoría,
	 	MAX(CASE WHEN t125B.f125_id_plan = ''C06'' THEN ISNULL(t106.f106_descripcion,'''') END) AS Tipo,
	 	MAX(CASE WHEN t125B.f125_id_plan = ''C13'' THEN ISNULL(t106.f106_descripcion,'''') END) AS Formatos,
	 	MAX(CASE WHEN t125B.f125_id_plan = ''C17'' THEN ISNULL(t106.f106_descripcion,'''') END) AS Marca,
	 	MAX(CASE WHEN t125B.f125_id_plan = ''C16'' THEN ISNULL(t106.f106_descripcion,'''') END) AS Origen,	
		ISNULL(t101.f101_descripcion,'''') AS Unidad_de_Empaque,
	 	MAX(CASE WHEN t125B.f125_id_plan = ''C07'' THEN ISNULL(t106.f106_descripcion,'''') END) AS Estilo,
	 	MAX(CASE WHEN t125B.f125_id_plan = ''C05'' THEN ISNULL(t106.f106_descripcion,'''') END) AS Uso,
	 	MAX(CASE WHEN t125B.f125_id_plan = ''C12'' THEN ISNULL(t106.f106_descripcion,'''') END) AS Tráfico,
	 	MAX(CASE WHEN t125B.f125_id_plan = ''C11'' THEN ISNULL(t106.f106_descripcion,'''') END) AS Variacion_tono
	 FROM t120_mc_items t120
	 INNER JOIN t125_mc_items_criterios t125A		
		ON t125A.f125_rowid_item = t120.f120_rowid 
	 	AND t125A.f125_id_cia = 1
	 INNER JOIN t125_mc_items_criterios t125B		
		ON t125B.f125_rowid_item = t120.f120_rowid 
	 	AND t125B.f125_id_cia = 1
	 INNER JOIN t106_mc_criterios_item_mayores t106	
		ON t106.f106_id_cia = t125B.f125_id_cia 
	 	AND t106.f106_id_plan = t125B.f125_id_plan 
	 	AND t106.f106_id = t125B.f125_id_criterio_mayor
		AND f106_id_cia = 1
	 INNER JOIN t122_mc_items_unidades t122 
		ON t120.f120_rowid = t122.f122_rowid_item 
		AND f122_id_cia = 1
		AND t120.f120_id_unidad_orden = t122.f122_id_unidad
	 INNER JOIN t101_mc_unidades_medida t101 
		ON t101.f101_id = t122.f122_id_unidad
		AND f101_id_cia = 1
	 WHERE t125A.f125_id_plan = ''C29'' 
	 	AND t125A.f125_id_criterio_mayor = ''001''
	 	AND t125B.f125_id_plan in (''C09'',''C10'',''C08'',''C01'',''C04'',''C23'',''C06'',''C13'',''C17'',''C16'',''C07'',''C05'',''C12'',''C11'')
	 GROUP BY t120.f120_id,t120.f120_referencia,t120.f120_id_unidad_orden,t122.f122_factor,t101.f101_descripcion
	'
) AS EspecificacionesProductoERP
INNER JOIN productos P ON CAST(f120_id AS NVARCHAR) = p.referencia_producto_erp AND p.sincronizado = 1
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM especificaciones_productos ep 
    WHERE ep.id_producto = p.id AND ep.id_producto_ecommerce = p.id_producto_ecommerce
	)

WITH ProductosFiltrados AS (
    SELECT 
        id_tienda,
        id_producto_ecommerce,
        referencia_producto_erp
    FROM 
        productos
    WHERE 
        id_tienda = 1
        --AND id_producto_ecommerce in ('11541','11514','11577','11579','11606','11607','11612')
        AND sincronizado = 1
)

INSERT INTO [dbo].[variantes] (
	id_tienda,
    id_producto_ecommerce, 
    id_variante_ecommerce, 
    sku_erp, 
	sincronizado, 
    fecha_sincronizacion,
    variante_obj
)

SELECT 
	pf.id_tienda,
    pf.id_producto_ecommerce,
    0 AS id_variante_ecommerce, 
    LTRIM(RTRIM(RawData.f120_id))	AS sku_erp,
    CAST(0 AS BIT) AS sincronizado, 
    GETDATE() AS fecha_sincronizacion,
    JSON_QUERY(( 
        SELECT 
            pf.id_producto_ecommerce AS ProductId,
            CAST('false' AS BIT) AS IsActive,
            CAST('true' AS BIT) AS ActivateIfPossible,
            UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(RawData.Descripcion_Ecommerce))) AS Name,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(RawData.f120_referencia)) AS RefId,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(RawData.f120_id)) AS Ean,
            10 AS PackagedHeight,
            10 AS PackagedLength,
            10 AS PackagedWidth,
            rawdata.f122_peso AS PackagedWeightKg,
            NULL AS Height,
            NULL AS Length,
            NULL AS Width,
            0 AS WeightKg,
            CAST(0 AS FLOAT) AS CubicWeight,
            CAST('false' AS BIT) AS IsKit,
            REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR, GETDATE(), 102), '.', '-') AS CreationDate,
            NULL AS RewardValue,
            NULL AS EstimatedDateArrival,
            UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(RawData.f122_factor))) AS ManufacturerCode,
            1 AS CommercialConditionId,
            'un' AS MeasurementUnit,
            1 AS UnitMultiplier,
            NULL AS ModalType,
            CAST('false' AS BIT) AS KitItensSellApart,
            NULL AS Videos
        FOR JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER, INCLUDE_NULL_VALUES
    )) AS variante_obj
FROM 
    ProductosFiltrados pf
INNER JOIN 
    OPENROWSET(
    'SQLNCLI11', 
    'Server=siesa-m4-sqlsw-db6.ceqnrhbwqaoo.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com;Database=UnoEE_Pisende_Real;Uid=Pisende;Pwd=Pisende$12$%;',
    '
        WITH ItemsConDescripciones AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT
                i.f120_id,
                i.f120_rowid,
                i.f120_rowid_movto_entidad,
                i.f120_id_grupo_impositivo,
                RTRIM(LTRIM(i.f120_referencia)) AS f120_referencia,
                i.f120_notas,
                RTRIM(LTRIM(i.f120_descripcion)) AS f120_descripcion,
                i.f120_descripcion_corta,
                i.f120_id_tipo_inv_serv,
                i.f120_id_unidad_inventario,
                i.f120_id_unidad_orden,
                MAX(CASE WHEN ic.f125_id_plan = ''C24'' THEN cm.f106_descripcion END) AS DescripcionPlanC24,
                MAX(CASE WHEN ic.f125_id_plan = ''C24'' THEN cm.f106_id END) AS IdCriterioC24,
                MAX(CASE WHEN ic.f125_id_plan = ''C29'' THEN cm.f106_descripcion END) AS DescripcionPlanC29,
                MAX(CASE WHEN ic.f125_id_plan = ''C29'' THEN cm.f106_id END) AS IdCriterioC29,
                MAX(CASE WHEN ic.f125_id_plan = ''C29'' THEN ic.f125_id_plan END) AS f125_id,
                MAX(CASE WHEN ic.f125_id_plan = ''C29'' THEN cm.f106_id END) AS f106_id,
                MAX(CASE WHEN ic.f125_id_plan = ''C29'' THEN cm.f106_descripcion END) AS f106_descripcion,
				u.f122_factor,
				u.f122_peso  * 1000 AS f122_peso
            FROM t120_mc_items i
            INNER JOIN t125_mc_items_criterios ic ON ic.f125_rowid_item = i.f120_rowid AND ic.f125_id_cia = 1
            INNER JOIN t106_mc_criterios_item_mayores cm ON cm.f106_id_cia = ic.f125_id_cia 
                                                    AND cm.f106_id_plan = ic.f125_id_plan
                                                    AND cm.f106_id = ic.f125_id_criterio_mayor
            INNER JOIN t105_mc_criterios_item_planes cp ON cp.f105_id_cia = cm.f106_id_cia 
                                                    AND cp.f105_id = cm.f106_id_plan
			inner join t122_mc_items_unidades u on i.f120_rowid = u.f122_rowid_item and i.f120_id_unidad_orden = u.f122_id_unidad
            WHERE i.f120_id_cia = 1
            AND cp.f105_id IN (''C24'', ''C29'')
            GROUP BY
                i.f120_id,
                i.f120_rowid,
                i.f120_rowid_movto_entidad,
                i.f120_id_grupo_impositivo,
                i.f120_referencia,
                i.f120_notas,
                i.f120_descripcion,
                i.f120_descripcion_corta,
                i.f120_id_tipo_inv_serv,
                i.f120_id_unidad_inventario,
                i.f120_id_unidad_orden,
				u.f122_factor,
				u.f122_peso
        )
        SELECT DISTINCT
            icd.f120_id,
            icd.f120_rowid,
            icd.f120_id_grupo_impositivo,
            icd.f120_referencia,
            icd.f120_notas,
            icd.f120_descripcion,
            icd.f106_descripcion,
            icd.f125_id,
            icd.f106_id,
            icd.f120_descripcion_corta,
            -- Subconsulta para Descripcion Ecommerce
            (SELECT TOP 1 f753_dato_texto
            FROM t750_mm_movto_entidad me
            INNER JOIN t753_mm_movto_entidad_columna mec ON me.f750_rowid = mec.f753_rowid_movto_entidad
            INNER JOIN t743_mm_entidad_atributo ea ON mec.f753_rowid_entidad_atributo = ea.f743_rowid
            WHERE me.f750_rowid = icd.f120_rowid_movto_entidad
            AND ea.f743_etiqueta = ''Descripcion Ecommerce'') AS Descripcion_Ecommerce,
            -- Subconsulta para KeyWords
            (SELECT TOP 1 f753_dato_texto
            FROM t750_mm_movto_entidad me
            INNER JOIN t753_mm_movto_entidad_columna mec ON me.f750_rowid = mec.f753_rowid_movto_entidad
            INNER JOIN t743_mm_entidad_atributo ea ON mec.f753_rowid_entidad_atributo = ea.f743_rowid
            WHERE me.f750_rowid = icd.f120_rowid_movto_entidad
            AND ea.f743_etiqueta = ''KeyWords'') AS KeyWords,
            -- Campos adicionales de C24 y C29
            icd.DescripcionPlanC24,
            icd.IdCriterioC24,
            icd.DescripcionPlanC29,
            icd.IdCriterioC29,
            icd.f120_id_tipo_inv_serv AS TipoInventario,
            icd.f120_id_unidad_inventario AS IdUnidadInventario,
            icd.f120_id_unidad_orden AS IdUnidadOrden,
			f122_factor,
			f122_peso
        FROM ItemsConDescripciones icd
        WHERE icd.DescripcionPlanC29 = ''APLICA''
        AND icd.IdCriterioC24 IN (''1'', ''2'', ''3'', ''4'', ''5'', ''6'', ''7'', ''8'')
        AND icd.f106_descripcion <> ''''
        AND icd.f106_descripcion IS NOT NULL
        AND icd.f106_descripcion <> ''NO APLICA''
        AND icd.f106_id = ''001'';
    '
	) AS RawData ON pf.referencia_producto_erp = CAST(RawData.f120_id AS NVARCHAR)
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT * 
    FROM variantes v 
    WHERE v.id_producto_ecommerce = pf.id_producto_ecommerce
		and v.sku_erp = pf.referencia_producto_erp
	)

MERGE INTO dbo.precios AS target

USING (

    SELECT DISTINCT

        p.id_tienda,

        v.id AS id_variante,

        v.id_variante_ecommerce,

        v.sku_erp,

        JSON_QUERY('{

            "markup": 0,

            "basePrice": ' + FORMAT(erp.f126_precio, '####') + ',

            "listPrice": ' + FORMAT(erp.f126_precio, '####') + ',

            "fixedPrices": [

                {

                    "tradePolicyId": "1",

                    "value": ' + FORMAT(erp.f126_precio, '####') + ',

                    "listPrice": ' + FORMAT(erp.f126_precio, '####') + ',

                    "minQuantity": 1

                }

            ]

        }') AS precio_obj,

        0 AS sincronizado,

        GETDATE() AS fecha_sincronizacion

-- Paso 1: Inventario ERP agrupado por variante y bodega
-- Se elimina #Variantes_Pisende (redundante, el JOIN ya está aquí)
-- Se elimina el CASE (f150_id ya viene filtrado con los valores exactos)
SELECT 
    p.id_tienda,
    MIN(v.id) AS id_variante,
    v.id_variante_ecommerce,
    MIN(v.sku_erp) AS sku_erp,
    erp.f150_id AS id_bodega_ecommerce,
    SUM(CAST(erp.disponible AS INT)) AS cantidad
INTO #InventarioERP_Pisende
FROM variantes v
INNER JOIN productos p 
    ON p.id_producto_ecommerce = v.id_producto_ecommerce
    AND p.id_tienda = 1
INNER JOIN OPENROWSET(
    'SQLNCLI',
    'Server=siesa-m4-sqlsw-db6.ceqnrhbwqaoo.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com;Database=UnoEE_Pisende_Real;Uid=Pisende;Pwd=Pisende$12$%;',
    '
     WITH ranked_lotes AS (
        SELECT 
            t120.f120_id_cia,
            f120_id,
            f120_referencia,
            f150_id,
            f403_id,
            t120.f120_id_unidad_inventario,
            t120.f120_id_unidad_orden,
            -- Aplicación combinada de reglas de negocio:
            CASE 
                -- Si es de Pisos y Paredes (C24 = 1) Y maneja lote: exige umbral > 5, de lo contrario envía 0
                WHEN c24.f125_id_criterio_mayor = ''1'' AND t403.f403_id IS NOT NULL THEN 
                    CASE 
                        WHEN (((t401.f401_cant_existencia_1 - t401.f401_cant_comprometida_1) - t401.f401_cant_salida_sin_conf_1) / f122_factor) > 5 
                        THEN ((t401.f401_cant_existencia_1 - t401.f401_cant_comprometida_1) - t401.f401_cant_salida_sin_conf_1) / f122_factor
                        ELSE 0 
                    END
                -- Para el resto de productos: regla normal de stock > 0
                ELSE 
                    CASE 
                        WHEN ((t401.f401_cant_existencia_1 - t401.f401_cant_comprometida_1) - t401.f401_cant_salida_sin_conf_1) / f122_factor > 0 
                        THEN ((t401.f401_cant_existencia_1 - t401.f401_cant_comprometida_1) - t401.f401_cant_salida_sin_conf_1) / f122_factor
                        ELSE 0 
                    END
            END AS Disponible,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY f150_id, f120_referencia 
                ORDER BY ((t401.f401_cant_existencia_1 - t401.f401_cant_comprometida_1) - t401.f401_cant_salida_sin_conf_1) DESC
            ) as rn
        FROM t401_cm_existencia_lote t401
        INNER JOIN t150_mc_bodegas t150 
            ON t150.f150_rowid = t401.f401_rowid_bodega
            AND f150_id IN (''BD001'',''BDVIR'',''BDAPG'',''OUT01'')
        LEFT JOIN t403_cm_lotes t403
            ON t403.f403_id_cia = t401.f401_id_cia
            AND t403.f403_id = t401.f401_id_lote
            AND t403.f403_rowid_item_ext = t401.f401_rowid_item_ext
            AND t403.f403_ind_estado = 1
        INNER JOIN t121_mc_items_extensiones t121 
            ON t121.f121_rowid = t401.f401_rowid_item_ext
        INNER JOIN t120_mc_items t120 
            ON t120.f120_rowid = t121.f121_rowid_item
        INNER JOIN t122_mc_items_unidades  
            ON f120_rowid = f122_rowid_item 
            AND f120_id_unidad_orden = f122_id_unidad
        -- Criterio C29 (Obligatorio para que se integre a e-commerce)
        INNER JOIN t125_mc_items_criterios c29
            ON c29.f125_rowid_item = f120_rowid 
            AND c29.f125_id_cia = 1
            AND c29.f125_id_plan = ''C29''
            AND c29.f125_id_criterio_mayor = ''001''
        -- Criterio C24 (Para identificar Pisos y Paredes)
        LEFT JOIN t125_mc_items_criterios c24 
            ON c24.f125_rowid_item = f120_rowid 
            AND c24.f125_id_cia = 1
            AND c24.f125_id_plan = ''C24''
        WHERE (
            (t401.f401_cant_existencia_1 - t401.f401_cant_comprometida_1 - t401.f401_cant_salida_sin_conf_1) >= 0
        )
    )
    SELECT
        f120_id_cia,
        f120_id,
        f120_referencia,
        f150_id,
        f403_id,
        f120_id_unidad_inventario,
        f120_id_unidad_orden,
        Disponible
    FROM ranked_lotes
    WHERE rn = 1
    '
) AS erp
    ON CAST(erp.f120_id AS NVARCHAR(20)) = v.sku_erp
WHERE v.sincronizado = 1
GROUP BY p.id_tienda, v.id_variante_ecommerce, erp.f150_id;

-- Pedidos cortos conservan la convención actual: sufijos 01 y 02 sobre orderId.
-- Pedidos largos (por ejemplo DDD) usan sequence + 01 para PED y sequence + 02 para TMS.
-- También se reconocen las referencias antiguas basadas únicamente en sequence,
-- para no volver a generar un PED/TMS que ya haya sido creado con la lógica anterior.
SELECT
    o.*,
    refs.referencia_PED,
    refs.referencia_TMS,
    shipping.valor_shipping,
    CASE
        WHEN TRY_CAST(shipping.valor_shipping AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) > 0 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS tiene_flete,
    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM #PedidosERP erp
            WHERE erp.f430_id_tipo_docto = 'PED'
              AND (
                    erp.f430_num_docto_referencia = refs.referencia_PED
                    OR (
                        LEN(REPLACE(datos.order_id, '-', '')) > 15
                        AND erp.f430_num_docto_referencia = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(datos.sequence)), '')
                    )
              )
        ) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS existe_PED,
    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM #PedidosERP erp
            WHERE erp.f430_id_tipo_docto = 'TMS'
              AND (
                    erp.f430_num_docto_referencia = refs.referencia_TMS
                    OR (
                        LEN(REPLACE(datos.order_id, '-', '')) > 15
                        AND erp.f430_num_docto_referencia = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(datos.sequence)), '')
                    )
              )
        ) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS existe_TMS
INTO #ordenes_revision
FROM dbo.ordenes o
CROSS APPLY (
    SELECT
        JSON_VALUE(o.orden_obj_origen, '$.orderId') AS order_id,
        JSON_VALUE(o.orden_obj_origen, '$.sequence') AS sequence
) AS datos
CROSS APPLY (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN LEN(REPLACE(datos.order_id, '-', '')) <= 15
                THEN REPLACE(datos.order_id, '-01', '01')
            WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(datos.sequence)), '') IS NOT NULL
                THEN CONCAT(LTRIM(RTRIM(datos.sequence)), '01')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS referencia_PED,
        CASE
            WHEN LEN(REPLACE(datos.order_id, '-', '')) <= 15
                THEN REPLACE(datos.order_id, '-01', '02')
            WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(datos.sequence)), '') IS NOT NULL

						   WHEN ISNULL(JSON_VALUE(o.orden_obj_origen, '$.clientProfileData.corporateDocument'), '') = ''

                                ''
                            ) IS NOT NULL
                            AND CHARINDEX(
                                '#',
                                JSON_VALUE(deliveryIds.value, '$.warehouseId')
                            ) = 0
                        )
                    ORDER BY
                        CASE
                            WHEN JSON_VALUE(kit.value, '$.ItemId') = i.Id THEN 0
                            ELSE 1

            -- tiene_flete ya confirma que existe Shipping y que su valor es mayor que cero.
            WHERE o.tiene_flete = 1
